name: Hotel Okura Amsterdam
elevationDatum: Local flat exterior grade y=0; real metres +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Mapped rotation baked once; no terrain or Mercator scale.
note: Published building height is 78 m, with no clear antenna datum. The canopy is modelled at 78 m and the photo-estimated 3.5 m mast gives an 81.5 m tip; both are explicitly approximate. OSM supplies the 78 m shaft and lower 2.5–13 m wing parts. The source shaft is shortened to 74 m for the open rooftop level and canopy supports. An additional authored canopy ring extends 3 m beyond the mapped shaft, inside the retained hotel envelope where possible; the ring is an estimated roof overhang, not another OSM way. Northern detached spa/conference buildings are excluded.
